CSharpMath.Rendering embeds these upstream font resources:
  Latin Modern Math — GUST Font License
  Cyrillic Modern — SIL Open Font License 1.1
  AMS Capital Blackboard Bold — SIL Open Font License 1.1
Font metadata, names, and attribution remain embedded in the unmodified library.
License texts are included alongside this notice.

The renderer runs locally. No browser engine, JavaScript, CDN or external font download is used.
